mechanism: E2 activates epithelial ERalpha.
model_assumption: Receptor activity, not ESR1 expression; progestin down-regulation of ERalpha is not represented.

mechanism: Progestin (P4 or MPA) activates the epithelial progesterone receptor.
model_assumption: E_PGR is receptor activity, not PGR expression; E2 induction of PGR expression is not represented.

mechanism: PGR-dependent epithelial Indian hedgehog expression.
model_assumption: Inherited from the prototype. Graded per-edge support is weak; evidence is topic-level and largely mouse.

mechanism: FGFR blockade (PD173074) in Hand2-deficient mouse uterus lowers epithelial phospho-FRS2 and phospho-ERK1/2.
model_assumption: Mouse evidence (moderate, partial support). Human receptor and ligand pairing unresolved.

mechanism: Secretory differentiation is induced under E2 priming followed by the progestin-containing step.
model_assumption: ADOC regimen supplies E2 throughout; E2-free differentiation is not represented.

mechanism: Epithelial secretory programme (PAEP) rises after the progestin-containing step.
model_assumption: MPA, cAMP and XAV939 are applied together in the supplemented regimen, so the response cannot be attributed to the progestin alone.

mechanism: E2 drives epithelial proliferation.
model_assumption: Executed without curated provenance in v0.6.0 (PAR-003). Contradicted in mouse: epithelial ERalpha is neither necessary nor sufficient for E2-induced epithelial proliferation (ET-029, full text). It changes no prediction (E_ESR1 and S_ESR1 both equal IN_E2) and is queued for removal in the next model revision (docs/model_construction.md, OQ-09).

mechanism: Epithelial Ki67 falls with FGFR blockade in Hand2-deficient mouse uterus.
model_assumption: Default Q2 hypothesis (stromal relay).

mechanism: IHH is secreted and reaches the stroma.
model_assumption: Secretion and transport across the ADOC membrane. A relay node: it adds a delay and never changes a steady state (see the alias classes in structure.json).

mechanism: The stromal mitogen is secreted and reaches the epithelium.
model_assumption: Secretion and transport across the ADOC membrane. A relay node: it adds a delay and never changes a steady state (see the alias classes in structure.json).

mechanism: BMP2 is secreted and acts on stromal BMP receptors.
model_assumption: Secretion and transport across the ADOC membrane. A relay node: it adds a delay and never changes a steady state (see the alias classes in structure.json).

mechanism: PAEP (glycodelin) is secreted by secretory epithelium and measured in ADOC outlets.
model_assumption: Outlet not verified in the source data (OM-001).

mechanism: PRL is secreted into the basal outlet and measured by ELISA in ADOC.
model_assumption: Column-to-chip mapping of the published values is lost (LOST-002).

mechanism: IGFBP-1 is secreted and measured by ELISA in ADOC outlets.
model_assumption: Compartment-ambiguous: detected apically and basally.

mechanism: E2 activates stromal ERalpha.
model_assumption: Receptor activity, not ESR1 expression.

mechanism: Progestin activates the stromal progesterone receptor.
model_assumption: Separate from E_PGR so that compartment-specific receptor perturbations remain expressible.

mechanism: 8-Br-cAMP activates stromal PKA signalling.
model_assumption: Epithelial cAMP effects are not represented.

mechanism: cAMP increases C/EBPbeta binding at the IGFBP1 and PRL promoters in human ESC.
model_assumption: C/EBPbeta expression and binding are lumped.

mechanism: AS1842856 inhibits FOXO1 transcriptional activity.
model_assumption: Candidate perturbation; target engagement by nuclear FOXO1 or a FOXO1 target such as IGFBP1.

mechanism: 8-Br-cAMP confines FOXO1 to the nucleus in human ESC (immunofluorescence and fractionation).
model_assumption: Progestin co-treatment attenuates, but does not abolish, nuclear FOXO1; that attenuation is not encoded (the prototype's PIF-001).

mechanism: Liganded PR binds an IRF4 regulatory interval in decidualising human ESC (ChIP-seq).
model_assumption: IRF4 is treated as a PR-FOXO1 target gene.

mechanism: FOXO1 is required for PR binding at the IRF4 interval (siFOXO1, ChIP-qPCR).
model_assumption: Conjunctive (AND) with PGR.

mechanism: A Smoothened antagonist blocks Hedgehog signal transduction.
model_assumption: Candidate perturbation; target engagement would be read by GLI1/PTCH1 transcripts. Epithelial effects are not represented.

mechanism: IHH engages stromal PTCH1/SMO/GLI signalling (human target-gene expression across the cycle; stromal Smo reduction defers implantation in mouse).
model_assumption: No human evidence that reception is required for NR2F2 or HAND2 induction (the prototype's GAP-014). The node was refused in the prototype as an exact alias of IHH; IN_SMO_INHIBITOR now gives it a determinant.

mechanism: Stromal PGR is required for the NR2F2 response.
model_assumption: Conjunctive (AND) with Hedgehog reception.

mechanism: Hedgehog signalling induces stromal COUP-TFII (NR2F2).
model_assumption: Mouse evidence; conjunctive (AND) with PGR.

mechanism: Hormone-treated ADOC stroma expresses BMP2 (scRNA-seq).
model_assumption: Expression programme evidence; does not prove the rule.

mechanism: cAMP arm of the BMP2 induction gate.
model_assumption: Executed without curated provenance in v0.6.0 (PAR-004). Absorbed in v0.1.0; in v0.2.0 it matters whenever Hedgehog reception is blocked, which makes the hormone-only versus supplemented difference testable.

mechanism: COUP-TFII controls stromal BMP2 (mouse, with BMP2 add-back rescue).
model_assumption: Mouse evidence.

mechanism: A BMP type I receptor inhibitor blocks SMAD1/5/8 phosphorylation.
model_assumption: Target engagement must be confirmed experimentally (pSMAD1/5/8, Task 1.4). Effects on the epithelium are not represented.

mechanism: BMP2 ligand signals through type I/II BMP receptors to phosphorylate SMAD1/5/8; pSMAD1/5 is measured in human ESC during decidualization.
model_assumption: Receptor availability and antagonists are not represented.

mechanism: BMP2 raises WNT4 in human stromal cells on top of the hormone mixture; SMAD1/5 knockdown lowers WNT4 (human ESC).
model_assumption: WNT4 regulation by IRF4 and by PGR is not represented.

mechanism: Progesterone induces stromal HAND2 (absent in PR-null mouse uterus; induced in human decidualization).
model_assumption: HAND2 is maintained by PGR independently of BMP signalling.

mechanism: Inherited S_BMP2 -> S_HAND2 dependency, routed through the receptor step because a ligand acts only through its receptor.
model_assumption: Redundant in the unperturbed network (HAND2 equals S_PGR whenever BMP signalling is possible).

mechanism: Stromal oestrogen receptors mediate the mitogenic effect of E2 on uterine epithelium (mouse tissue recombination, ET-029); stromal FGFs are the paracrine mediators (ET-005).
model_assumption: Mouse evidence, both read in full. ET-029 did not identify the paracrine factor. ESR1 expression is not regulated in the model.

mechanism: HAND2 represses stromal mitogenic ligand expression (Fgf1/2/9/18 in mouse; FGF9 only in human ESC).
model_assumption: Ligand identity of the human epithelial mitogen is unresolved.

mechanism: IL-1beta engages IL-1 receptor signalling in stromal cells.
model_assumption: Epithelial IL-1 responses are not represented.

mechanism: IL-1beta activates JNK in human ESC.
model_assumption: Abstract-level reading.

mechanism: IL-1beta causes rapid ERK1/2-dependent phosphorylation in human ESC.
model_assumption: Abstract-level reading.

mechanism: Progesterone receptor signalling is required for stromal decidualization.
model_assumption: Required in every Q1 variant.

mechanism: C/EBPbeta binding is needed for cAMP induction of IGFBP-1 and PRL in human ESC.
model_assumption: Replaces the v0.1.0 direct cAMP/PKA requirement with its transcriptional mediator.

mechanism: Wnt4 knockdown blocks BMP2-driven decidualization (mouse); SMAD1/5 knockdown impairs human decidualization with WNT4 down, and BMP2 rescues.
model_assumption: Default Q1 hypothesis (BMP required). The alternative Q1_pgr_sufficient removes this dependency.

mechanism: IL-1beta impairs human stromal decidualization through JNK (PRL and IGFBP-1 reduced in four studies).
model_assumption: Abstract-level for the JNK route; ERK1/2 is reported as the route by ET-015. Present in every Q1 variant. Provisional until G2 data.

mechanism: FOXO1 binds the IGFBP1 promoter with PR, and FOXO1 knockdown or activity inhibition lowers IGFBP1 in human stromal cells (four concordant studies).
model_assumption: The FOXO1 x PGR interaction sign is cell-type dependent (ET-025); encoded only as a FOXO1 requirement.

mechanism: IGFBP1 is a marker gene of the decidual programme.
model_assumption: Marker expression requires the programme.

mechanism: IRF4 knockdown attenuates PRL; FOXO1 knockdown lowers PRL in decidual fibroblasts.
model_assumption: Default FOX hypothesis. FOXO1 activity inhibition leaves PRL unchanged (ET-024) and FOXO1 alone is inert on the PRL enhancer (ET-026): the alternative FOX_prl_foxo1_independent drops this edge.

mechanism: PRL is a marker gene of the decidual programme.
model_assumption: Marker expression requires the programme.

mechanism: Direct HAND2 term of the legacy v0.5.1 representation (variant Q2_relay_plus_direct_v051).
model_assumption: No paper supports a direct epithelial HAND2 edge; retained to reproduce the v0.5.1 vs v0.5.2 transient comparison.

mechanism: Epithelial PGR suppresses E2-driven proliferation without stromal mediation (variant Q2_epithelial_autonomous).
model_assumption: Alternative required by the grant question Q2; no corpus paper supports it as the primary route.

mechanism: IL-1beta depletes stromal PR through ERK1/2; ERK1/2 blockade restores PR (variant INF_pgr_depletion).
model_assumption: Abstract-level reading; Boolean loss of S_PGR simplifies partial depletion. ERalpha depletion reported in the same study is not represented.
